entities.name: Eugène Pehoua-Pelema
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugène Pehoua-Pelema is a former basketball player from the Central African Republic. He competed at the 1988 Summer Olympics with the Central African Republic national basketball team. He later led the team as the National Technical Director and Head Coach in 2009–2010.
